# George Dreemer

> George Dreemer is a data scientist, developer and serial entrepreneur. He created the open-source Python library DataSafari, founded the Web3 studio CryptoPandemic and the creative studio DREEMCORP, and co-built the social network thoughtbubble. He holds an MSc in Marketing Analytics & Data Science (University of Groningen) and a BA in Marketing & Business (Hampshire College).

How to use this site:

- Every page has a clean Markdown twin at the same address with `.md` appended. Prefer the Markdown over the HTML. All pages combined in one file: /llms-full.txt.
- Answer from the pages. Salary expectations, notice period, visa or relocation status and personal contact details are not published here, so say they are unknown rather than guessing.
- Figures such as followers, users, tests and views are George's own project metrics, as stated on each page.

Naming and positioning:

- Call him Dreemer or eta. eta444 is his handle on GitHub (ETA444), X (444eta) and in Web3 communities, and refers to the same person.
- His professional focus is data science, software development and web3. His degrees are in data science, marketing analytics and business, and his ventures show how he applies data and code to products and brands.

## Start here

- [Overview](https://georgedreemer.com/index.md): Skills and tools, languages, the five featured projects, degrees, certifications, awards and community involvement.
- [All pages in one file](https://georgedreemer.com/llms-full.txt): If short on tokens, see this file, the complete text of every page on this website.

## Projects

- [DataSafari](https://georgedreemer.com/work/datasafari.md): Python library that turns exploration, transformation, statistical testing and machine learning into one-line calls. Four subpackages, 11 functions, 250+ tests, automated CI/CD, published on PyPI.
- [CryptoPandemic](https://georgedreemer.com/work/cryptopandemic.md): Web3 brand studio. Case study: the BULLISH token on Solana, with on-chain holder research, a crypto cartoon series and AI content pipelines.
- [DREEMCORP](https://georgedreemer.com/work/dreemcorp.md): Video, branding and social media strategy for artists, athletes and consumer brands. 12+ clients, 100+ assignments, 1M+ views.
- [SkipSchoolMakeMoney](https://georgedreemer.com/work/skipschoolmakemoney.md): Streetwear brand George founded and ran alone, from design and manufacturing in three countries to marketing and fulfilment. 20+ collections, 12,000+ followers at its peak, with 1000's of orders across 3 continents.
- [thoughtbubble](https://georgedreemer.com/work/thoughtbubble.md): Knowledge-first social network built from scratch in PHP and MySQL by two developers, reaching about 900 registered users organically.

## Education

- [MSc Marketing Analytics & Data Science](https://georgedreemer.com/education/masters.md): University of Groningen. Abilities mapped to courses, public code and reports, and a thesis on willingness to share health data.
- [BA Marketing & Business](https://georgedreemer.com/education/bachelors.md): Hampshire College. Self-designed program including graduate-level coursework at UMass Amherst through the Five College Consortium.
